desc_zh: 定制背胶印刷成品，可根据项目需求进行裁切、覆膜，并选择卷装或单张交付。
desc_en: Custom printed self-adhesive graphics with trimming and lamination options, supplied in rolls or cut sheets.

detail_zh.lead: 适用于标识、促销和展示项目的定制背胶印刷成品。可安排印刷、裁切和覆膜，并根据订单选择卷装或单张交付。
delivery: 按指定尺寸裁切成单张
根据交付形式和目的地核算包装及运费
detail_zh.artwork: 可接收印刷文件，也可提供文件准备服务。基础文件检查和简单调整可免费提供；较大幅度修改或从零设计需单独报价。
detail_zh.brief: 请说明成品尺寸、数量、使用场景、覆膜要求、卷装或单张偏好、设计文件及目的地。
detail_zh.caveat: 胶水类型、底纸、表面效果、厚度以及对特定基材或环境的适用性，需按具体产品要求确认后报价。

detail_en.lead: Custom printed self-adhesive vinyl graphics for signage, promotional and display projects. Printing, trimming and lamination can be arranged, with roll or cut-sheet delivery based on the job.
applications: Custom adhesive graphics for project use
delivery: Packing and freight assessed by order format and destination
detail_en.artwork: Supply a print-ready file or request artwork preparation. Basic file checks and minor adjustments are available at no extra cost; extensive modifications or original design work are quoted separately.
detail_en.brief: Please specify finished dimensions, quantity, intended application, lamination requirement, roll or sheet preference, artwork and destination.
detail_en.caveat: Adhesive type, liner, surface finish, thickness and suitability for a particular substrate or environment must be confirmed for the requested product before quotation.
